title: Combinations
summary: List every selection of k different integers from 1 through n.

contractDetails.constraints: 1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 20. Return arrays of exactly k integers.
contractDetails.output-checking: Compare complete sets of sorted tuples. Reject missing, repeated, or invalid combinations. Both outer ordering and order within a tuple are irrelevant.

statement: List every selection of k different integers from 1 through n. A selection is determined by its members. Return each selection once. Both collection order and member order are unrestricted.

examples.explanation: There are three distinct two-value choices.
Each value gives a separate singleton.

constraints: 1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 20. Return arrays of exactly k integers.
hints: Conceptual: Changing the order of selected values does not create a new choice.
Directional: Build selections in increasing order to avoid duplicates.
Implementation: Carry the smallest eligible next value. Stop trying a candidate when the remaining range cannot fill the remaining slots.
complexityAnalysis: O(k × C(n,k)) time including output and O(k) auxiliary recursion space.
